description:
#Join us!

##Duration
2 Hours

##About
This is the same tour as our original but using electric bikes instead. Our guided Coronado Tour begins at the Coronado Island Marriott Resort and Spa where we roll along the harbor with a beautiful view of the San Diego skyline on our side. Our tour continues as we make our way through the tree lined roads of this slice of heaven, past some of the most architecturally distinct homes, including "Hansel & Gretel" and "Wizard of Oz" to the historic Hotel Del Coronado. Here you'll have time to explore this famous landmark as well as the #1 rated beach in America. 

Learn some history and a secret about the upcoming New Top Gun Movie that is sure to impress your friends and family. Also, you will view some of our amazing public art works and discover the many things to do on Coronado.
